subject: gk
question: Pawan Hans Helicopters Limited provides helicopter services to whom in its off-shore operations?
solution:
The correct asnwer is __**Oil and Natural Gas Corporation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The government has finalized disinvestment for helicopter service provider Pawan Hans Ltd.
 
• An empowered cabinet group picked Star9 Mobility Private Ltd as the winner for buying a 51% stake in Pawan Hans.
 
• Pawan Hans provides air transport services for exploration activities of Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd. 
 
• The federal government has a 51% stake in Pawan Hans, while ONGC holds 49%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pawan Hans Limited is a government-owned helicopter service provider.
 
• ​Pawan Hans Limited​:
 
 
• Founded: 15 October 1985
 
• Headquarters: Noida
 
• Fleet size: 43
 
• Hub: Juhu Airport
